u03-open.by: Densify (agent), clause-by-clause check against the Greek, 2026-10-09
u03-open.resolution: I checked each flag against the Greek and found no meaning error. 'Can you, he says, O Job, do what the Only-begotten later accomplished? …' renders Δύνασαι οὖν, φησίν, ὦ Ἰὼβ …, which is in the Greek, and so is 'How does it happen, he says? Such is the beast …' (Πῶς γίνεται, φησί; τοιοῦτόν ἐστι θηρίον ἄγριον καὶ δυνατὸν καὶ ἀπόπληκτον); the 'invented' flags came from chunk boundaries. 'I have dealt with you' for κεχρηματικέναι follows the standard rendering of LXX Job 40:8. 'He caught Leviathan like a fish' renders ἰχθὺν ἤγρευσεν Λευιαθάν idiomatically. 'Let it happen no longer' renders μηκέτι γινέσθω. 'So it is not for display, nor for all the other things, nor even for knowledge of God' follows the printed Οὐκ ἄρα πρὸς ἐπίδειξιν ἢ πρὸς καὶ τὰ ἄλλα πάντα, ἢ καὶ πρὸς θεογνωσίαν. 'Terrifying' for ἀπόπληκτον ('stunning, paralysing') and 'striking' for χρίμψασθαι are within range.
